requirements.outcome: Live track/bus meters refresh and decay smoothly while foreground or background.
The Project header shows a live track meter beside the color strip.
Device Setup and VST Connections/F4 are reachable through Devices, with Audio configuration duplication removed.
An optional local backend opens the installed x64 Mackie ASIO driver for full-duplex audio.
Driver controls show resolved names, supported rates, actual buffers/latencies and vendor Control Panel.
Persistent mono/stereo buses map physical channels and are shared across Project, Inspector, Mixer and Channel Settings.
Inputs and Outputs tables retain the supplied parent/child rows, columns, tab hierarchy and control grouping.
Recording produces correctly encoded 16-bit PCM, 24-bit PCM or 32-bit float WAV files as selected.
Project sample-rate selection includes 44.1/48 kHz with correct conversion when capture differs.
Project settings/status show actual record rate/resolution and storage-derived time.
Browser/game coexistence, deliberate release and lowest stable buffer are qualified for each selected backend.
New format/bus/backend settings survive reopen and driver failure without losing the project or changing an unrelated device.
Track and Channel Settings L/R meters follow post-processing gain and pan.
Stereo Out meters display the actual summed L/R output.
Stereo In meters display physical input without enabling audible track monitoring.
Mono tracks default to a mono input and stereo tracks can select the full Stereo In bus consistently across views.
Device Setup and Connections retain the supplied tree/page and tabbed table structure, density, columns, and nesting.
An already-created project exposes editable rate and PCM16/PCM24/Float32 settings through discoverable Project Setup actions.
Both existing device buses have independent shared Mixer/Channel Settings controls and correct editor targeting.
Input processing reaches monitored/recorded samples exactly once; output processing affects the final sum and matching stereo meters.
Both bus settings survive save/reopen and undo, and old projects default to neutral buses without arrange lanes.
Device Setup is roughly half its former height with reachable scrollable pages.
Undo removes new recording files and events; redo restores exact files without deleting imported media or corrupting saved references.
Growing route-correct waveforms are drawn during capture from recorded frames without callback drawing work.
Signed stereo waveforms reveal transients at pixel density and individual decoded samples at close zoom. Drawing uses the full lane height while retaining true amplitude.
Closing with Discard deletes recorder-created takes since the last save, preserves imported/saved audio and works beyond undo-history trimming.
Mixer/Channel Settings/Inspector share fine channel gain control, -30 dB audible floor, bottom zero-gain mute and positive headroom with persistence.
Stereo In/Out Channel Settings have no Sends sections or customization entries while normal track Sends/layout preferences remain available.
Retain per-channel maximum dB until reset, red above 0 dB, shared stereo meters with red headroom.
Live selected-channel FFT with pre/post inserts/EQ selection for tracks and device buses, without callback FFT/allocation.
Orange comparison spectrum/EQ response of another channel, reset to Post/None on owner change or close.
File Preferences opens from empty shell/project with retained hierarchy, transactional global settings, unsupported pages clearly planned and no Video/Scores.
Configurable hold time and slow/fast dB-per-second decay drive shared Project/Mixer/Channel Settings bar and peak-marker display with session max retained.
Adjustable display-only spectrum release smoothing with immediate attack and raw option.
Map routed input-bus signal to audio-track meters during hardware Direct Monitoring.
Project rate changes warn/confirm mismatched or unavailable media; original files/timing/pitch remain and playback resamples; rate change is undoable and recording guarded.
Fader/EQ/insert parameter snapshot changes crossfade over a short bounded transition to reduce clicks during playback.
When input monitoring is enabled for a track during playback, that track emits its live input and suppresses its recorded clips and instrument; other tracks continue.
Overlapping recorded takes remain separate, the newest/topmost take is visible and audible, and deliberate X-crossfades remain audible.
Output/Input/track Channel Settings opens reliably via all entry points, restores hidden/minimized windows, and reopens after close without stale shared-window failure.
Always on Top keeps Channel Settings above Project/Mixer while dialogs and external programs can cover it; confirmations remain reachable.

live-meters.description: Project/Mixer meters remain responsive and correctly routed while backgrounded.

mackie-driver.description: The exact installed Mackie ASIO driver is active and correct physical inputs/outputs work.

coexistence.description: Backend sharing/release/stability behavior is demonstrated with other apps.

wav-integrity.description: Selected resolution/rate is independently verified in recorded/reopened WAV samples and headers.

persistence.description: Settings/routes reopen correctly, preserve old projects and recover device errors.

channel-control-review.description: User exercises precise/mute/positive faders, audible headroom, persistence and correct bus/normal track editor sections on current build.

spectrum-review.description: Live audio tracks/device buses show correct peak holds, over-zero red, timely Pre/Post spectrum and orange comparison; close/channel reset verified. Direct live MIDI per-track gap remains explicit.

preferences-meter-review.description: Live meter feel, timed marker and bar/spectrum rates, global persistence and Apply/Cancel/Defaults/OK verified without project dirtying. Hardware Direct Monitoring remains absent.

project-rate-review.description: Disposable project old-rate media confirmation/cancel/conform/Undo/persistence plus live pitch/timing and missing-media behavior verified.

parameter-change-listening.description: Adjust track gain and EQ while audio plays; no objectionable pops/dropouts, level jumps, or broken playback.

monitor-exclusive-listening.description: During playback, an armed/monitored track outputs only its selected live input; toggling monitoring restores its clips without affecting other tracks.

overdub-take-review.description: Record over an existing event; new event is displayed above and is the only audible take in overlap, outside explicit X-crossfades. Existing takes remain recoverable.

channel-window-desktop.description: Live Output/Input/track repeated open/close plus hidden/minimized restore, application pin, quit/config/native dialogs and external application ordering are verified.
